label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= ~85), earlier onset after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass) and almost only in the last ~15 trials of a 100-trial episode (87% of mass in trials 90-99, 12% in 80-89, ~0 before trial 50), so it acts as a late-episode clock / end-of-episode signal and coincides with the lowest value-head outputs (92% of mass at value < 5.22). Within that window it prefers GO steps after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward 0 has 2x lift; rewarded input never fires) and after a D1 fixation break (in_rew = -1, 85% rate), and it is stronger when the policy strongly favours a2. Magnitude rises with trial index across consecutive trials in a window. Never fires at D1 or D2 or on rewarded-input steps. Simplest predicate GO & ep_trial >= 85 has mass recall 0.98 but precision 0.19; the recorded one (adds: unrewarded previous trial, or trial >= 95) gives dev F1 0.48, mass recall 0.95. Precision is still low: many late GO steps stay silent, with no clean observable rule for which. Uses only observed variables (ep_trial is implicit time).
